Callout.Name: Major Incident - Forward Command
Callout.Message: Major incident declared, forward command point needed.
Callout.Advisory: Several agencies on scene, no unified command.

Script.Line: Nobody knows who is in charge. That is the problem.
Three services, three radios, and I have been on all three.
Give me one frequency and one point and I will sort the rest.

Lines.Approach: Everybody is shouting into a different radio. What is needed is one point and one voice.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
